articles.title: Singapore's top university destroys tumors with magnetic pulses, no chemo needed
articles.content: Researchers at the National University of Singapore have used brief pulses of a weak magnetic field to eliminate breast tumors in 75% of the mice they tested, without any chemotherapy.

articles.title: Chinese nationals face 40 years over kidnapping of Singaporean at Malaysia airport
articles.content: They face one count under Section 3(1) of the Kidnapping Act 1961, read with Section 34 of the Penal Code, which covers acts carried out with common intention. Conviction carries 30 to 40 years in prison and caning.

articles.title: Humans must become wiser to coexist with AI 'species'
articles.content: Last June, I taught a class on AI at a summer camp for 60 students aged 12 to 20.

articles.title: Tech workers spiral into anxiety, exhaustion because of 'age 35 curse'
articles.content: Shutting his laptop at 3:00 a.m. with vision blurred after a grueling 16-hour shift, 27-year-old The Vinh found sleep impossible, his limbs trembling with fatigue.

articles.title: US colleges are so short of students they're admitting people who never applied
articles.content: Hundreds of U.S. colleges are admitting high school students who never applied, as the number of American 18-year-olds begins a long decline.

articles.title: Passengers wait for 6 hours to collect baggage at Thailand's largest airport amid heavy flooding
articles.content: Passengers arriving at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport had to wait up to six hours for their bags, while luggage from several flights was left behind amid disruptions to Thai Airways's ground operations.

articles.title: Plane with 296 people on board forced to land in Portugal as smoke appears in cabin
articles.content: A Boston-bound Delta Air Lines jet made an emergency landing in Porto, Portugal, on Sept. 27 after smoke appeared in the passenger cabin, sending four passengers to a hospital.

articles.title: Bangkok shoppers empty store shelves as flood paralyzes city
articles.content: Heavy rain and flooding across Bangkok have led residents to stock up on food and essentials in the weekend, emptying shelves at some convenience stores amid concerns about travel disruptions and possible shortages.

articles.title: Gold prices drop to 6-week low
articles.content: Vietnam's gold prices fell to the lowest in nearly 6 weeks on Monday amid an over 2% slump in global bullion rates.

articles.title: Trump's granddaughter welcomes Xi in Mandarin, 9 years after singing a Chinese folk song for him
articles.content: Arabella Kushner, U.S. President Donald Trump's 15-year-old granddaughter, greeted Chinese President Xi Jinping in Mandarin at the White House last week, nine years after she first sang for the Chinese leader.

articles.title: Jet ski rider charged for drifting through floodwaters on Bangkok main street
articles.content: A man who rode a jet ski through submerged Bangkok, making waves along Phetchaburi Road, a major artery in the Thai capital, was arrested and charged with 'causing a public nuisance.'

articles.title: Wife of Malaysia's longest-serving PM Mahathir dies aged 100
articles.content: Siti Hasmah Mohamad Ali, the wife of Malaysia's longest-serving Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad and a public health advocate, died Monday at the age of 100, the veteran leader's office said.

articles.title: Vietnamese overseas workers getting younger
articles.content: Vietnamese guest workers going abroad have a median age of 27, one lower than in 2021 and much lower than the 40-42 for people working in Vietnam.

articles.title: Ho Chi Minh City warns of severe flooding as high tides peak at 1.85 m
articles.content: Ho Chi Minh City is forecast to experience high tides of 1.6 to 1.85 meters from Sept. 28 to 30, exceeding a Level 3 alert, the highest and most critical warning in Vietnam's river flood warning system.

articles.title: Vietnam police uncover online gambling ring with over $38.6M in transactions processed
articles.content: Police in the northern province of Hung Yen have uncovered an online gambling ring operating through the Net.win website, with transactions worth more than VND1 trillion (US$38.61 million) processed through bank accounts linked to the system, authorities have said.

articles.title: Sneaker billionaire behind the biggest university gift in US history gives his alma mater $1B
articles.content: Nike co-founder Phil Knight and his wife, Penny, have pledged US$1 billion to the University of Oregon to create an engineering college, the largest known gift to a U.S. public flagship university.

articles.title: Dollar dips against dong
articles.content: The U.S. dollar weakened against the Vietnamese dong Monday morning while trading near a two-month high against some major peers.

articles.title: Award-winning chemist leaves US professorship 2 months after promotion to return to China
articles.content: Chinese chemist Haotian Wang has joined Tongji University, just two months after being promoted to full professor at Rice University in the U.S.

articles.title: Which Southeast Asian university named world’s second best for engineering?
articles.content: This Southeast Asian university ranks second globally for engineering in the 2026–2027 U.S. News Best Global Universities rankings.

articles.title: Chinese PhD quits psychiatrist career to deliver food, sing at bars
articles.content: A 31-year-old Chinese PhD quit her psychiatrist career to deliver food and sing at bars, saying she wanted greater freedom and control over her time.

articles.title: Vietnamese professor at top US public school behind $44M research on earthquakes, aircraft
articles.content: Bui Thanh Tan never expected to become a professor, but now tackles problems from earthquakes to aircraft engines and medicine, with his research projects receiving over US$44 million in funding.

articles.title: Silicon Valley tech giants launch $42M college alternative with no degree
articles.content: U.S. venture capital billionaires and tech giants are backing a new two-year college alternative offering 'AI-native' education for young people seeking careers or entrepreneurial opportunities in technology.

articles.title: Harvard University named world's best in 16 STEM subjects
articles.content: Harvard University leads universities worldwide with 16 STEM subjects ranked first globally in the latest U.S. News Best Global Universities subject rankings.

articles.title: World's most valuable AI startup to open Singapore office in October, hire locally
articles.content: Anthropic, the world's most valuable AI startup at US$965 billion, will open a Singapore office in October and hire locally for a range of roles.

articles.title: Thailand mobilizes soldiers to tackle baggage backlog at Bangkok airport
articles.content: Soldiers were deployed Monday to help clear a baggage backlog at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport after widespread flooding prevented many ground-handling staff from reporting to work, causing flight delays over the weekend.

articles.title: Hundreds of Korean passengers stranded at Bangkok airport for 14 hours amid heavy flooding
articles.content: Hundreds of Korean passengers scheduled to fly home with Thai Airways were stranded for more than 14 hours at Thailand's Suvarnabhumi Airport from Sunday night after heavy flooding in Bangkok disrupted departures.

articles.title: Thailand airlines offer free flight changes as Bangkok flooding disrupts travel
articles.content: Thai airlines have introduced special measures, including free flight changes and travel credits, for passengers affected by flooding and severe traffic congestion in the capital Bangkok.
